rules.fol:
fof(lsr1_lsr1, axiom,
  ! [T, W, Z] :
    ( ( person(W)
        & machine_guard_zone(Z)
        & ! [S] : (within(S, T, 5) => in(W, Z, S)) )
      => alert(bypassing_safety_controls, critical, W, T) )).
rules.paraphrase: If a worker X1 is for at least 5 seconds in a machine-guard-zone then VisionGuard raises a critical bypassing-safety-controls-alert for the worker X1.
readback: VisionGuard raises a critical Bypassing Safety Controls alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 1) about the worker when:
the worker is in the machine-guard-zone for at least 5 seconds
rules.text: If a worker is in a machine-guard-zone for at least 5 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical bypassing-safety-controls-alert for the worker.

rules.fol:
fof(lsr2_lsr2, axiom,
  ! [T, W, Z] :
    ( ( person(W)
        & confined_space(Z)
        & in(W, Z, T)
        & ! [S] : (within(S, T, 10) => ~ (? [G] : (gas_detector(G) & carry(W, G, S)))) )
      => alert(confined_space, critical, W, T) )).
rules.paraphrase: If a worker X1 is in a confined-space and it is false that the worker X1 carries a gas-detector for at least 10 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical confined-space-alert for the worker X1.
readback: VisionGuard raises a critical Confined Space alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 2) about the worker when:
the worker is in the confined-space
the worker is not seen carrying a gas-detector for at least 10 seconds
rules.text: If a worker is in a confined-space and does not carry a gas-detector for at least 10 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical confined-space-alert for the worker.

rules.fol:
fof(lsr3_lsr3, axiom,
  ! [T, W, V] :
    ( ( person(W)
        & vehicle(V)
        & drive(W, V, T)
        & ! [S] : (within(S, T, 3) => ? [P] : (phone(P) & use(W, P, S))) )
      => alert(driving, critical, W, T) )).
rules.paraphrase: If a worker X1 drives a vehicle and the worker X1 uses a phone for at least 3 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical driving-alert for the worker X1.
readback: VisionGuard raises a critical Driving alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 3) about the worker when:
the worker is seen driving a vehicle
the worker is seen using a phone for at least 3 seconds
rules.text: If a worker drives a vehicle and uses a phone for at least 3 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical driving-alert for the worker.

rules.paraphrase: If a worker X1 is in a live-equipment-zone X2 and it is false that the live-equipment-zone X2 has an isolation-certificate for at least 5 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical energy-isolation-alert for the worker X1.
readback: VisionGuard raises a critical Energy Isolation alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 4) about the worker when:
the worker is in the live-equipment-zone
the live-equipment-zone has no isolation-certificate (according to the isolation register (LOTO)) for at least 5 seconds
rules.text: If a worker is in a live-equipment-zone and the live-equipment-zone does not have an isolation-certificate for at least 5 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical energy-isolation-alert for the worker.

rules.text: If a flame is in a hot-work-area and the hot-work-area does not have a permit for at least 5 seconds then VisionGuard raises a critical hot-work-alert.

fof(lsr8_unless, axiom,
  ! [T, W, Z] :
    ( ( person(W)
        & restricted_area(Z) & zone_id(Z, 'Moonpool') & camera_of(Z, 'CAM-02')

        & ~ (? [R] : (permit(R) & have(Z, R, T)))
        & ~ (? [R2] : (permit(R2) & have(W, R2, T))) )
      => alert(work_authorisation, high, W, T) )).

readback: VisionGuard raises a high Work Authorisation alert (IOGP Life-Saving Rule 8) about the worker when:
the worker is in Moonpool for at least 5 seconds
unless Moonpool has a permit (from the permit-to-work system)
unless the worker has a permit (from the permit-to-work system)
rules.text: If a worker is in Moonpool for at least 5 seconds then VisionGuard raises a high work-authorisation-alert for the worker unless Moonpool has a permit or the worker has a permit.

semantics.alert lifecycle: per (rule, subject): IDLE -> ACTIVE when the rule's antecedent holds (alert raised once, with proof) -> COOLING when it stops holding -> IDLE after cooldown_seconds; re-raised only from IDLE
semantics.counts: 'at least N workers' requires N distinct believed objects that satisfy every condition on them
semantics.duration: 'for at least D seconds' means the believed condition held at every frame time in [T-D, T]; 'for more than D seconds' is the same with a strict bound
semantics.evidence: a detected fact (object, zone membership, relation) stays believed for grace_seconds after it was last observed; a fact never observed, or not observed for longer than grace_seconds, is believed absent
semantics.fol: each rule's 'fol' is a TPTP fof formula over believed facts at time T; the head is alert(Lsr, Severity, Subject, T)
semantics.negation: 'does not wear a harness' holds when no harness is believed associated with the subject; negated visual conditions require a duration (positive-evidence policy)
semantics.time: rules are evaluated at every frame time T
